# scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Checks that a repo's docs agree with its code and with the brain's facts of record (docs consistency, D1 to D11).

Runs the checks in docs/docs-spec.md section 6 on one repo (this one by default), or with -All on this repo and every connected repo ./scripts/Sync-BrainSources.ps1 checked out: links and paths (D1), entry points (D2), parameters (D3), contracts (D4), paired decisions (D5), the changelog (D6), connection tables (D7), terms (D8), knowledge citations (D9), generated text (D10) and the privacy of generated text (D11). Nothing runs a script or calls a model; scripts are parsed. One line per finding, then RESULT PASS or RESULT FAIL. During the rollout (docs-spec section 12) only D11 fails the run; -Enforce makes every error fail it. -JsonPath writes the findings as avd-doc-findings/v1 (docs/contracts.md C13) for avd-swarm's Scribe. A repo accepts a finding by its key, with a reason, in docs/accepted-findings.json; D11 can't be accepted.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-RepoPath` | string | no | `(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)` | The repo to check; this one by default. |
| `-RepoName` | string | no |  | Its name as sources/sources.json has it; the folder name by default. |
| `-BrainPath` | string | no | `(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)` | A checkout of avd-second-brain, for the facts of record. |
| `-All` | switch | no |  | Check this repo and every connected repo checked out under -SourcesRoot (the nightly sweep). |
| `-SourcesRoot` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) '.sources')` | Where Sync-BrainSources.ps1 checked out the connected repos. |
| `-JsonPath` | string | no |  | Write the findings to this file as avd-doc-findings/v1 (contract C13). |
| `-ChangedFile` | string[] | no | `@()` | The files a pull request changes, for the changelog check (D6). |
| `-PullRequestBody` | string | no |  | The pull request's body, for its "Changelog:" line (D6). |
| `-Enforce` | switch | no |  | Fail on any error, not only on D11. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1
```
```powershell
./scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1 -RepoPath ../avd-swarm -RepoName avd-swarm
```
```powershell
./scripts/Sync-BrainSources.ps1 -AllowMissing; ./scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1 -All -JsonPath ./doc-findings.json
```
